svg.title: Figure 2. The clock
svg.desc: The box's timers and the chat-side tasks on a 24-hour weekday dial, with the week and the month below. Generated from deploy/systemd and docs/master-guide/chat-tasks.yaml.
svg.text: Blue: the box's timers. Orange: chat-side tasks. Ringed: a report you read.
Sat 08:00 Weekly crypto tech scan (Pearl and new mechanisms)
by event, 07:10 MSTR / MSCI watch (2-30 Nov, 1 Dec)
Times are ET. A task held in UTC moves an hour
when daylight saving ends on 1 Nov.
